Name: WarpToFarm
Author: Exxude
Description:
Warp player to farm upon keybind press.

Uses Stamina to warp.

Config:

[code]{
  "General": {
"ModEnabled": true, // True enables the mod.
"StaminaCost": 100.0, // Stamina cost. Technically can be anything.
"WarpButton": "F2, LeftShoulder + X" // See below...
  },
  "Tweaks": {
"WarpPosX": 64, // Farm Position Left/Right (Might need to be played around with on modded maps.)
"WarpPosY": 15, // Farm Position Up/Down (Might need to be played around with on modded maps.)
"WarpDirection": 1  // The direction the player should face (0=up, 1=right, 2=down, 3=left)
  }
}


Keybinds:
Single Keybind ------ "F2"
Multiple Keybinds --- "F2, F3"
Combination Keybind - "LeftShoulder + X"

[/code]
